# The `causalsimkit` package {#sec-causalsimkit}

The estimators used in every chapter live in `src/causalsimkit/`, a small package with truth-recovery tests: each estimator must recover the effect planted in its simulated data.

## Setup

```bash
uv sync --extra dev --extra render   # create .venv and install causalsimkit in editable mode
uv run pytest -q                     # estimators must recover the planted effects
uv run quarto render                 # build the book
```

The chapters also work without installing the package: `_setup.qmd` falls back to `./src` on the path.

## Layout

```text
src/causalsimkit/
  ols.py          OLS/WLS with HC1 and cluster-robust (CR1) SEs, Wald tests
  did.py          2x2, TWFE, event study, Callaway–Sant'Anna ATT(g,t)
  synth.py        synthetic control, DiD counterfactual, placebos, backtests
  events.py       market-model abnormal returns, CAR aggregation
  rdd.py          local polynomial RD, binned means, density test
  propensity.py   propensity fit, SMD balance, IPW, AIPW, cross-fit AIPW, matching
  experiments.py  matched pairs, TBR, randomization inference, switchback design/analysis
  simulate.py     data-generating processes with known ground truth
  utils.py        cluster bootstrap
tests/            truth-recovery tests for every estimator
```

## Source of truth

The chapters in this book replace the original Jupyter notebooks, which were generated from cell specs. The `.qmd` files are now the source: edit a chapter, re-render, and results update. Chapter results are cached in `_freeze/`; delete a chapter's folder there (or the whole directory) to force a re-run.

## Production libraries

| Need | Libraries |
|---|---|
| RD inference | `rdrobust`, `rddensity`, `rdlocrand` |
| Staggered DiD, fixed effects | `pyfixest`, `csdid`, `differences`, `linearmodels` |
| Synthetic control | `pysyncon`, `SparseSC`, `tfcausalimpact` |
| Observational causal inference | `DoWhy`, `EconML`, `causalml`, `zEpid` |
| Geo experiments | `GeoLift`, `matched_markets`, `GeoexperimentsResearch` |
